title: Memory harness completion and reliability evidence
summary: 17 dedicated tests pass; 29 agreement sections mapped; actual canonical evidence is individually retrievable; fresh-process navigation and concurrent-write rejection passed.
body: Fixed invalid source metadata accepted on save, out-of-bounds references, historical corruption omitted by doctor, and doubled CRLF output on Windows. Application generation and automatic worker-controller enforcement are later checkpoints. User acceptance is pending.
